question: Sikandra is the final resting place of Emperor ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Akbar__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikandra is the final resting place of Emperor Akbar.**
 
• The monument is in Sikandra, Agra (previously known as **Akbarabad, **or the land of king Akbar).
 
• It is a **fine example of Mughal architecture **and was built during the peak of the Mughal rule. 
 
• Its **construction was started by Akbar in 1605 and completed by Jahangir.**
 
• **Sikandra was named after Sikander Lodi.​**
